data.narrative: The student coordinated three scoped contract reviews and used an interface-first approach to find and fix the missing comment audit side effect. A single transaction now records the comment, safe AuditLog metadata, and matching ActivityEvent before post-commit publication; combined mocked tests and the Nest build passed, while live PostgreSQL/HTTP behavior remains unverified.

dimension_scores.evidence: The work specified mutation/audit/activity ordering, safe comment metadata, post-commit publication, and the PostgreSQL unavailability boundary.

dimension_scores.evidence: The reflection records the comment audit omission, payload shape difference, process-local feed limit, and DTO/HTTP verification boundary.

strengths: Coordinates parallel domain reviews without concurrent edits to shared implementation files.
Keeps audit and activity effects atomic and publishes only after transaction commit.
Uses safe audit metadata and distinguishes mocked verification from live system proof.
data.recommendation: When the guarded url_shortener_test database is reachable, verify comment creation and audit/activity persistence through authenticated HTTP, then test subscriber fan-out across instances using shared pub/sub before making production-scale claims.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: The student connected component contracts to cross-feature data flow, audit effects, activity delivery, and shared-file ownership.

concepts_demonstrated.concept: Atomic side effects and post-commit publication
concepts_demonstrated.evidence: The comment mutation, safe AuditLog row, and ActivityEvent are written in one transaction, and the mocked publisher checks commit ordering.
The student distinguishes nine passing mocked tests and a successful build from unexecuted live PostgreSQL/HTTP and multi-instance checks.

teaching_approaches.detail: Used the comment creation path to show how primary data, audit data, and activity data align across one transaction.
Compared comment, audit, and feed contracts to identify the missing audit side effect and differing REST/SSE shapes.

learning_style_signals: Uses explicit contracts, test names, and command outputs to reason about integration behavior.

public_evidence.student_action: Added a comment audit write in the same transaction as the comment and activity event, then verified publication occurs after commit.

public_evidence.proof: Combined mocked Jest output reports 2 suites and 9 tests passed; the direct Nest build exited 0; git diff --check exited 0.
